resources.string: DomainGuard provides simple and advanced ways to block access to the internet - no root required. Apps and addresses can individually be allowed or denied access to your Wi-Fi and/or mobile connection.
Xposed causes too many crashes, which might result in DomainGuard being removed from the Google Play Store, therefore DomainGuard isn\'t supported while Xposed is installed
Great care has been taken to develop and test DomainGuard, however it is impossible to guarantee DomainGuard will work correctly on every device.
NetGuard needs your help. Tap to purchase pro features to keep the project going.
